Think of a road trip. You don't park with gas still in the tank. Leftover time is fuel for checking your answers.
Here's your pace. Math is thirty five minutes for twenty two questions. That's about a minute and a half each.
Reading and Writing is thirty two minutes for twenty seven questions. That's about a minute and ten seconds each.
Rule one. If you finish early, go back and verify. Plug answers back in, reread the last line of each question, and check the FIND.
Rule two. If you're stuck for more than about three minutes, make your best guess, flag it, and move on. One question isn't worth three others.
Rule three. Never leave a blank. There's no penalty for guessing. A blank is a zero percent chance. A guess is at least a twenty five percent chance.
